svg.title: The greenlight pipeline
svg.desc: Ten stages, read left to right: 01 Scout (scripts), 02 Analyst, 03 Critic, 04 Board (issues), 05 Architect, 06 Reviewer, 07 Factory, 08 Inspector (AI plus checks), 09 Publisher (no AI), 10 Observer. Two human gates: you add the label approved between Board and Architect, and blueprint-ok between Reviewer and Factory. The Observer's weekly-report.md feeds back into the Board.
